name: Researcher Phase Transition → GATHER
description: ADR-041 Slice 2D-3 forward/back-edge spawn rule. Fires when phasevalidator.PhaseValidator has approved a transition to the gather phase (any allowed source — plan forward, synthesize back-edge, architect back-edge) and stamped chain.phase_transition.proceed.gather="true" on the source researcher loop entity. The validator has already checked the edge against the allowed-set AND the per-phase cap (max 3 gather fires per chain); rule fires only when both gates pass. Two-step fire shape mirrors the recoverycounter→rule_02 pattern: triggering loop's terminal triples land first, validator wakes on the same agent.complete and writes the proceed sentinel, the loop's entity_watcher re-evaluates, this rule's condition now passes, fires.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.researcher-gather
on_enter.prompt: GATHER phase entry. Source loop $entity.instance has handed off with decide(action="gather"). Call read_loop_result on that loop to read the upstream phase's narrative terminal (plan's scope + verifiable outcomes, or synthesize/architect's back-edge reason naming a corpus gap). Then use web_search to ground the plan's actor names + integration points in external facts (protocol specifics, framework APIs, library behavior). Accumulate findings in scratchpad per researcher-gather/20-iteration-rules.md. Per ADR-041 addendum 2026-05-15: chain agents do not read the graph; web_search is your only external evidence channel. Terminate with decide(action="synthesize", reason="<one-sentence summary of evidence accumulated>") when the upstream questions are covered, OR decide(action="needs_clarification", reason="<why web_search could not resolve the plan's question>") when external evidence is structurally insufficient.

metadata.proceed_sentinel: chain.phase_transition.proceed.gather on source researcher loop entity. Absence-of-sentinel blocks the rule fire fail-safe.
metadata.phase_cap: Per-phase cap = 3 (ADR-041 §Per-phase cap). Validator enforces; this rule trusts the sentinel.
metadata.chain_agent_no_graph_reads_note: ADR-041 addendum 2026-05-15: chain agents (researcher, builder, reviewer) do NOT read the graph. The graph is internal harness state — audit, lineage, milestone stamping, evidence aggregation. Only ops agents (whose named job IS observing harness state per ADR-027) read it. PR #152 added summarize_graph + query_by_type + query_entity + query_entities to this rule based on a misread of the original ADR-041 graph-posture text; rolled back here. web_search remains — it grounds in external facts (not the graph). See docs/adr/041-mvp-role-compression-and-graph-as-substrate.md §'Addendum 2026-05-15'. Structural pin: test/contract/adr041_persona_dirs_test.go:TestADR041_ChainAgentsCannotReadGraph.
metadata.smoke_27_success_criterion: A healthy first-pass gather loop emits >=1 web_search call before its terminal decide(synthesize). 0 web_search calls on a clean smoke run suggests the persona workflow isn't grounding — investigate persona prompting and/or web_search result quality, NOT graph-tool re-introduction (which the contract test forbids).
